stem.text: Which statement about B-lymphocytes **and** T-lymphocytes is correct?

A.text: They become active only when a specific antibody binds to their surface receptor.

B.text: They divide to form clones when meeting an antitoxin in a cell.

C.text: They produce memory cells to respond to an antigen when exposed in the future.

D.text: They release hormone-like cytokines which stimulate release of antibodies.
